result.instructions: Tools for SamCart, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many orders did we get this week, and what were the totals by product?"; "Which subscriptions are scheduled to cancel this month?"; "Show the customer record and purchase history for jane@example.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SamCart data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run samcart_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run samcart_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run samcart_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. samcart_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: samcart_get_daily_sales_report
tools.title: Daily sales report
tools.description: Daily sales rows for a date range: gross sales, net revenue, orders, refunds, recurring and one-time sales, upsells, views and conversion. Amounts are in the smallest currency unit. API: GET /reports/daily-sales.

tools.name: samcart_get_mrr_report
tools.title: Monthly recurring revenue
tools.description: Current monthly recurring revenue (MRR) of the marketplace's active subscriptions. API: GET /reports/mrr.

tools.name: samcart_update_order_custom_fields
tools.title: Update order custom fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one order. Only the slugs you send change. An empty string or null ERASES the stored value. Slugs come from the custom_fields map of samcart_get_order. API: PATCH /orders/{id}.

order_id.description: The order id (a ULID, from a list call).

custom_fields.description: Values keyed by custom field slug, e.g. {"onboarding_status": "sent"}.

tools.name: samcart_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.title: Cancel a subscription now
tools.description: CANCEL a subscription immediately. Only active, delinquent or paused subscriptions can be canceled. The customer is notified unless silent_cancel is true. There is no undo through this tool. API: POST /subscriptions/{id}/cancel.

subscription_id.description: The subscription id (a ULID, from a list call).

silent_cancel.description: true = do not notify the customer. Default false.

tools.name: samcart_schedule_customer_cancellation
tools.title: Schedule a subscription cancellation
tools.description: SCHEDULE a cancellation for an active subscription: at the end of the current billing period (end_of_period) or on a custom future date (custom, needs cancel_date YYYY-MM-DD). API: POST /subscriptions/{id}/schedule-cancel.

subscription_id.description: The subscription id (a ULID, from a list call).

cancel_date.description: Required when cancel_when is custom: the day to cancel, YYYY-MM-DD.
